nodes.description: OwnableUpgradeSafe._owner: privileged owner address that gates renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Permissions.contractManager: registry used to resolve every external system contract address.
Punisher._locked: per-holder slashed and locked token amounts.
ContractManager.contracts: bytes32 name hash to implementation address mapping.
BountyV2._epochPool: accumulated bounty pool for the current epoch.
BountyV2._nextEpoch: next epoch index that still needs to be refilled.
BountyV2._bountyWasPaidInCurrentEpoch: bounty already paid within the current epoch.
TokenState._lockers: list of locker contract names aggregated for lock accounting.
DelegationController.delegations: array holding every delegation record.
DelegationController._firstUnprocessedSlashByHolder: slash processing cursor per holder.
Nodes.nodes: array of all registered node records and their statuses.
Nodes.spaceOfNodes: free space bookkeeping per node.
KeyStorage._schainsPublicKeys: common BLS public key of each schain.
AccessControlUpgradeSafe._roles: role to member set and admin role mapping.
DelegationPeriodManager.stakeMultipliers: delegation period to stake multiplier.
SchainsInternal.numberOfSchains: total count of schains created.
Address.sendValue: sends ETH with a low-level call that forwards all available gas.
Address.isContract: extcodehash based contract detection helper.
ECDSA.recover: recovers the signer address from a signature using ecrecover.
ContractManager.setContractsAddress: onlyOwner setter of contract registry entries.
Punisher.slash: allow(SkaleDKG) entry point that triggers delegation confiscation.
Punisher.forgive: onlyAdmin reduction of a holder locked amount.
Punisher.handleSlash: allow(DelegationController) increase of the locked amount.
Punisher.getAndUpdateLockedAmount: ILocker hook processing slashes then returning locked.
Schains.addSchain: allow(SkaleManager) schain creation with deposit and lifetime checks.
Schains.deleteSchain: allow(SkaleManager) removal of an schain owned by from.
Schains.deleteSchainByRoot: allow(SkaleManager) forced schain removal.
SkaleManager.tokensReceived: IERC777Recipient hook that forwards to Schains.addSchain.
SkaleManager.createNode: permissionless node registration entry point.
SkaleManager.nodeExit: permissioned node exit flow.
SkaleManager.getBounty: computes and pays the bounty for a node.
SkaleManager._payBounty: mints bounty tokens to the Distributor.
BountyV2.calculateBounty: allow(SkaleManager) epoch pool refill and bounty computation.
DelegationController.delegate: creates a new delegation proposal.
DelegationController.requestUndelegation: starts undelegation and processes slashes.
DelegationController.confiscate: allow(Punisher) stake slashing of a validator.
Distributor.withdrawBounty: transfers earned bounty to a destination address.
Permissions.initialize: grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the initializing caller.
DelegationController.processAllSlashes: applies all pending slashes of a holder.
NodeRotation.rotateNode: allowTwo entry removing and replacing a node in an schain.
NodeRotation.selectNodeToGroup: pseudo-random node selection using blockhash.
Nodes.changeNodeLastRewardDate: allow(SkaleManager) reward date update.
SchainsInternal._generateGroup: pseudo-random schain group generation.
SkaleVerifier.verify: BLS signature verification through bn256 pairing.
Distributor.tokensReceived: allow(SkaleToken) hook distributing the minted bounty.
DelegationController.getAndUpdateDelegatedToValidatorNow: current delegated total.
Permissions.allow: modifier restricting the caller to a named contract or the owner.
AccessControlUpgradeSafe.grantRole: admin-role gated role granting.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used throughout permission checks.
block.timestamp / now: miner-influenced time used in reward and schain logic.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _owner by onlyOwner before the contract registry is mutated.
slash is gated by allow("SkaleDKG") which validates msg.sender against the registry.
forgive is gated by onlyAdmin which resolves msg.sender roles.
handleSlash is gated by allow("DelegationController").
ILocker entry point callable by arbitrary wallets to query locked amounts.
addSchain is gated by allow("SkaleManager").
deleteSchain is gated by allow("SkaleManager") plus an owner check on from.
deleteSchainByRoot is reachable only through the onlyAdmin path of SkaleManager.
tokensReceived is gated by allow("SkaleToken") and forwards msg.sender derived from value.
createNode binds the newly created node to msg.sender as validator address.
nodeExit derives the permission flag from msg.sender node ownership or validator identity.
getBounty requires that msg.sender owns the rewarded node.
delegate uses msg.sender as the delegation holder.
requestUndelegation requires msg.sender to be the holder or the validator.
withdrawBounty credits the accumulated bounty of msg.sender.
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender.
grantRole requires msg.sender to hold the admin role of the granted role.
the allow modifier compares msg.sender with contractManager.getContract(name).
public delegation accounting entry point invoked by callers.
nodeExit uses now to schedule the node finish time, making timing miner influenced.
calculateBounty relies on now for reward timing decisions.
changeNodeLastRewardDate stores block.timestamp as the reward anchor.
schain group generation derives randomness from block data.
selectNodeToGroup derives randomness from blockhash of the previous block.
